create_siglip2_image_text_model: create a Siglip2 model that encodes images and text into shared embedding space for similarity matching
run_siglip2_image_text_similarity: run Siglip2 to compute cosine similarity scores between image and text embeddings
build_siglip2_vision_encoder: build a Siglip2 vision encoder that processes images into pooled feature embeddings
build_siglip2_text_encoder: build a Siglip2 text encoder that processes tokenized text into pooled feature embeddings
test_siglip2_image_classification: test Siglip2 for image classification with a linear head on top of the vision encoder
